title: नेपालको उच्च शिक्षामा प्रमुख राजनीतिक दलहरूको दृष्टिकोण {Perspectives of the Major Political Parties on Higher Education of Nepal}
nepali: नेपालको राजनीतिक परिवर्तन र नीतिनिर्माणका तहमा प्रत्यक्ष प्रभाव पार्ने प्रमुख तीन राजनीतिक दलहरू नेपाली काङ्ग्रेस, नेकपा (एमाले), नेकपा (माओवादी केन्द्र) ले वि.सं. २०७९ साल मङ्सिर ४ गते सम्पन्न भएको प्रतिनिधि सभा तथा प्रदेश सभा निर्वाचन प्रयोजनका लगि जारी गरेको घोषणा पत्रमा केन्द्रित रही नेपालको उच्च शिक्षासम्बन्धी उनीहरूको दृष्टिकोणको अध्ययन विश्लेषण गर्नु यो लेखको उद्देश्य रहेको छ । प्रस्तुत अध्ययनले प्रमुख तीन दलहरूको धारणा र त्यसको कार्यान्वयनको अवस्थालाई उजागर गर्ने प्रयत्न गरेको छ । प्रमुख तीन राजनीतिक दलको पृष्ठभूमि र उनीहरूले २०७९ सालको संसदीय निर्वाचनपूर्व जारी गरेको घोषणापत्रलाई द्वितीयक स्रोतसामग्रीको रूपमा मूल आधार मानेर अध्ययन विश्लेषण गरिएको हुनाले यो लेख तथ्याङ्क सङ्कलनका हिसाबले पुस्तकालयीय, गुणात्मक र तथ्याङ्क विश्लेषणका हिसाबले विश्लेषणात्मक अध्ययन विधिमा आधारित छ । यस लेखले तिनको तुलनात्मक विश्लेषणसमेत गरेको छ । अध्ययनको नतिजास्वरूप उल्लिखित दलहरूको उच्च शिक्षासम्बन्धी दृष्टिकोणमा केही समानता र केही भिन्नता पाइयो । यस अध्ययनबाट उच्च शिक्षाका समस्या र तिनको समाधानका लागि दलहरूले व्यक्त गरेका विचारको आधारमा भावी नीति तय गर्न नीतिगत तहमा समेत मद्दत पुग्ने अपेक्षा गर्न सकिन्छ । {The objective of this article is to carry out a study and analyze the perspectives of the major three political parties on the higher education of Nepal political transformation and policy development in Nepal. This analysis is centered around the declaration of the elections of the House of Representatives and the Provincial Parliaments held on Mangsir 4, 2079 B.S. This article attempts to explore the three major political parties’ perspectives and the state of the implementation of the perspectives. The study has made an effort to illuminate the perspectives of the three major political parties and the state of their implementation. Analyzing the background of the three major political parties and their manifestos publicized before the parliamentary elections of 2079 B.S., this article mainly builds on the secondary source as the principal basis of the study. Because this study utilizes library resources, qualitative and statistical analysis, it is based on the analytical study method. As a result of the study, some similarities and differences regarding higher education were found in the perspectives of the above-stated political parties. This article also carries out a comparative analysis of those perspectives. As the study reveals, it can be expected that, on the basis of the thoughts articulated by the parties concerning the problems in higher education and their solutions, support might be obtained at the policy level to formulate future policies addressing the problems related to higher education and their solutions.}
american_english: The objective of this article is to study and analyze the views of the major three political parties — Nepali Congress, CPN (UML) and CPN (Maoist Centre) — which directly affect the political change and policy-making level in Nepal, regarding Nepal's higher education, focusing on the manifestos they issued for the House of Representatives and Provincial Assembly elections held on Mangsir 4, 2079 BS (B.S.). The present study has attempted to shed light on the positions of the major three parties and the state of their implementation. Since the study and analysis have been carried out on the basis of the background of the major three political parties and the manifestos they issued ahead of the 2079 parliamentary elections, treating them as secondary source material, this article is based, in terms of data collection, on library resources and, in terms of data analysis, on a qualitative, analytical study method. The article also carries out a comparative analysis of those parties. As a result of the study, some similarities and some differences were found in the views of the parties mentioned regarding higher education. From this study it can be expected that, on the basis of the ideas expressed by the parties for resolving the problems of higher education and reaching solutions to them, it will also help at the policy-making level in settling future policy.
british_english: The aim of this article is to study and analyse the views of the principal three political parties — Nepali Congress, CPN (UML) and CPN (Maoist Centre) — which exert a direct influence on political change and the policy-making level in Nepal, concerning Nepal's higher education, concentrating on the manifestos they issued for the House of Representatives and Provincial Assembly elections held on 4 Mangsir 2079 BS. The present study has sought to illuminate the positions of the principal three parties and the state of their implementation. As the study and analysis have been carried out on the basis of the background of the principal three political parties and the manifestos they issued before the 2079 parliamentary elections, treated as secondary source material, this article is based, in terms of data collection, on library sources and, in terms of data analysis, on a qualitative, analytical study method. The article also conducts a comparative analysis of those parties. As a result of the study, both similarities and differences were found in the views of the parties concerned regarding higher education. From this study it may be expected that, on the basis of the ideas expressed by the parties for solving the problems of higher education and finding their solutions, it will also assist at the policy-making level in framing future policy.

informal_english: The point of this article is to study and analyse the thinking of the three major political parties — Nepali Congress, CPN (UML) and CPN (Maoist Centre) — which directly shape political change and policy-making in Nepal, on Nepal's higher education, focusing on the manifestos they put out for the House of Representatives and Provincial Assembly elections held on Mangsir 4, 2079 BS. This study is basically an attempt to lay out what the three major parties think and how far those positions have actually been implemented. Since the study and analysis were built around the backgrounds of the three major parties and the manifestos they released before the 2079 parliamentary elections, treated as secondary source material, this article rests, data-wise, on library resources and, on the analysis side, on a qualitative, analytical study method. The article also does a comparative analysis of those parties. The study found that the parties concerned show some similarities and some differences in their views on higher education. From this, one may expect that, on the basis of what the parties have said by way of solving higher-education problems and their solutions, it will also help out at the policy-making level in setting future policy.
translator_notes: '2079 BS' = Bikram Sambat year; election date Mangsir 4, 2079 BS preserved verbatim. Party names rendered with common romanisation ( नेपाली काङ्ग्रेस, नेकपा (एमाले), नेकपा (माओवादी केन्द्र) ). Sentence order of Nepali preserved, including the closing 'expected assistance' sentence.
